post.text:

To stop climate change of course.

description.description: A composite image featuring a close-up portrait of Bill Gates looking thoughtfully to the left, which has been superimposed onto a landscape of a dense evergreen forest. Some of the treetops overlap with the bottom and sides of his face, and his skin texture appears partially blended with the patterns of the trees. The background shows a light blue, textured sky.
